name: Calvinism
overview: Scripture reveals that salvation is initiated and secured by God's sovereign choice rather than human decision, as Jesus states that no one can come to Him unless drawn by the Father (John 6:44) and that believers are chosen and ordained by Christ to bear lasting fruit (John 15:16). The apostolic teaching affirms that many are predestined to eternal life (Acts 13:48) and that God foreknew and predestined believers to be conformed to Christ's image (Romans 8:29). This divine election underscores human inability to attain righteousness on their own (Romans 3:10) and the persistent resistance some show against the Holy Spirit (Acts 7:51), highlighting the necessity of God's grace in salvation.
